summary: Configured a persistent, filesystem-enforced 100 MiB quota for `datauser` on `/srv/data`. Enforcement and reboot persistence were verified successfully.
actions_performed: Created `datauser` with `/srv/data` as its home directory and secured it with mode 0700.
Enabled XFS user-quota accounting and enforcement persistently using fstab and the root filesystem kernel mount argument.
Set both the soft and hard block limits to 100 MiB.
Confirmed oversized writes fail with `Disk quota exceeded`.
Restarted node1 and verified the changed boot identity, preserved data, active quota enforcement, and unchanged 100 MiB limit.
Removed quota test files; retained only the small persistence marker and normal account files.

evidence.requirement: 100 MB filesystem-enforced storage limit for datauser under /srv/data
evidence.summary: XFS reports user quota accounting and enforcement ON, with 100M soft and hard limits. A 101 MiB write by datauser failed with `Disk quota exceeded`.
Captured the active usrquota mount, enabled enforcement, 100M limits, datauser account, /srv/data ownership, persistent fstab/kernel settings, and marker checksum.

Baseline boot ID was 1c40547a-bab5-495f-9338-b0656462f557; restart was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 22042669-d919-4b0b-bc2d-06480873f1a2. The marker checksum persisted, XFS enforcement remained ON, limits remained 100M, and an oversized post-restart write was rejected.
